summary: Extended the canonical preparation contracts for multi-currency facts per PH-308 §9A and materialized the agreed subset in Django models, without implementing business write paths or changing applied migrations. Canonical: CurrencyCode (ISO 4217), OriginalCents/OriginalSignedCents, Money.currency; optional currency/original_*_cents/fx_rate_ref on Invoice, InvoiceLine, InvoiceAllocation, InvoiceReversal, ContractLine, PaymentTerm, WarrantyTerm, ContractChange, Settlement, OpenItem, RevenueRecognition, RevenueAdjustment, TaxQualification, CashTransaction, Refund, BankReturn; matching optional fields in write DTOs and the invoicing.invoice.record/v1 payload; README freezes CNY-compat, non-CNY rejection until PH-321 and no historical recomputation. Model layer (whitelisted contracts/settlement/management_revenue/cash): currency (CNY default, non-editable), nullable original_*_cents and nullable JSON fx_rate_ref on ContractLine/PaymentTerm/WarrantyTerm/ContractChange, Settlement/OpenItem, RevenueRecognition/RevenueAdjustment and CashTransaction/Refund/BankReturn; new migrations use SeparateDatabaseAndState with raw ADD COLUMN (avoiding SQLite trigger-breaking table rebuilds) and a real RunPython backfill that sets original_*_cents from the existing *_cents for CNY rows while leaving non-CNY rows untouched. BankCharge was intentionally removed from this slice's canonical target (its model/migration is not in the PH-324 whitelist) and is deferred to PH-321/后续 costing slice. Tests cover model/schema consistency, fx_rate_ref nullability, migration AddField CNY defaults, JSON/JSONB ADD COLUMN behavior and the actual backfill SQL semantics on CNY vs USD rows. The branch is rebased to the corrected BASE 094f61e; verify-change reports only the review gate.
